repos_data.description: A drop-in replacement for std::list with 293% faster insertion, 57% faster erasure, 17% faster iteration and 77% faster sorting on average. 20-24% speed increase in use-case testing.

An unordered C++ data container providing fast iteration/insertion/erasure while maintaining pointer/iterator validity to non-erased elements regardless of insertions/erasures. Provides higher-performance than std:: library containers for high-modification scenarios with unordered data.
A sort wrapper enabling both use of random-access sorting on non-random access containers, and increased performance for the sorting of large types.
stdgpu: Efficient STL-like Data Structures on the GPU
C++11/20 library that provides static_vector, small_vector, static_map, small_map, flat_map, static_flat_map, small_flat_map, static_unordered_map, small_unordered_map, etc.
A header-only library for C++(0x) that allows automagic pretty-printing of any container.
A C/C++ header file for fast 32-bit division remainders (and divisibility tests) on 64-bit hardware.
A simple C++ 03/11/etc timer class for ~microsecond-precision cross-platform benchmarking. The implementation is as limited and as simple as possible to create the lowest amount of overhead.
Fast and exact implementation of the C++ from_chars functions for number types: 4x to 10x faster than strtod, part of GCC 12, MySQL, DuckDB, Chromium, Redis and WebKit/Safari

repo_meta_data.description: A C++ data container replicating std::stack functionality but with better performance than standard library containers in a stack context.
